name: Rheon Systems CorpSec Fullmount Field Kit
description:
Head-to-toe CorpSec loadout: matte-black ceramic-composite helmet with integrated visor and neural-port passthrough, rigid chest-and-back plate carrier over a graphene-weave undersuit, articulated elbow and knee guards in gunmetal grey, and mag-sealed thigh pouches. Boots are composite-toe, anti-mag-mine soled. Chrome arm channels run along both sleeves; spinal rig cutouts are standard. Unit insignia patches are velcro-swappable — loyalty is contractual.

The undersuit is moisture-wicking thermal-regulate synthetic, charcoal with high-vis orange seam piping visible only under UV. Helmet visor is AR-overlay capable. Everything fits over mid-grade augmentation without retrofit.
functionality: Full ballistic and melee protection, neural-port passthrough helmet, AR visor overlay, chrome arm channels, spinal rig cutouts, mag-sealed utility pouches, thermal regulation undersuit, UV-reactive seam piping for low-vis ops.
what_it_says: You are the blunt instrument of a corponation's will — loyal until the contract runs out.
story_hooks: The unit insignia patch on this kit belongs to a dissolved corponation — whoever's wearing it either doesn't know or doesn't care.
A ripperdoc recognizes the spinal rig cutout dimensions as a proprietary Rheon design — one that was recalled after a field fatality.
The AR visor keeps flagging a civilian as a high-threat target. The override code requires command authorization no one is answering.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Thalamic Override Spike

physical_description.visual_profile: Full tactical body armor kit projecting corporate military authority—sleek, modular, built for function over aesthetics. Silhouette is broad-shouldered and geometric, with clean lines broken only by articulated joint guards and utility pouches. The figure appears engineered rather than dressed.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tight undersuit beneath articulated plating; structured and rigid where reinforced, allowing controlled mobility at joints. Chest plate sits flush against torso, thigh pouches seal against legs without bulk. Designed to accommodate subcutaneous and neural augmentations without gaps.
physical_description.primary_material: Ceramic-composite shell plating, graphene-weave undersuit base, gunmetal-grey reinforced polymer at joints, chrome-alloy arm channels, composite-toe boots with specialized sole technology
physical_description.texture: Matte finish on helmet and chest plates (non-reflective, tactical); slight grip texture on arm and leg guards; smooth synthetic weave visible at undersuit seams; metallic sheen along chrome sleeve channels
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant matte black throughout, gunmetal grey accents at elbows and knees, chrome metallic highlights along arm channels, charcoal undersuit with high-vis orange UV-reactive piping (concealed under normal light)
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap-seals on thigh pouches, friction-fit armor segments locking into place at shoulders and waist, helmet neural-port clasp system, boot lace-alternative tension straps
distinctive_features: Integrated AR-overlay visor with neural-port passthrough on helmet
Chrome arm channels running full sleeve length for tech integration or neural pathways
Spinal rig cutouts for backplate augmentation compatibility
Hidden high-vis orange seam piping visible only under UV light
Modular thigh pouch system with mag-seals
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 corporate security—high-end military-grade equipment, expensive material composition, cutting-edge integration tech. Only accessible to corpo loyalists or elite mercs on contract.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer is corporate security apparatus, mercenary, or sanctioned enforcer. Uniform signals obedience, expendability within hierarchy, neural-integration readiness. The swappable patches emphasize contractual loyalty over personal identity.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when issued; quickly shows wear through scuff marks on plating, dust accumulation in crevices, possible micro-fractures in ceramic composite from impact. Field units rarely look showroom-fresh past first deployment.

image_prompt: Sleek neo-noir CorpSec soldier in matte-black ceramic-composite tactical armor, standing rigid in three-quarter view against neon-lit industrial warehouse backdrop. Matte-black helmet with AR visor glowing faint blue, chrome arm channels catching overhead fluorescent light, gunmetal grey joint armor sharp and geometric. Undersuit visible at neck and wrists, high-contrast black and charcoal. Velcro insignia patches glow faintly corporate-branded. Anti-glare, tactical lighting from above left. Dark concrete floor, distant megacityscape haze. Shot from waist-up, stoic professional posture. Hyperrealistic materials, moody cool-toned color grade. --ar 2:3 --v 6
